an4.61:1.1: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an4.61:2.1: cattārome gahapati dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an4.61:2.3: bhogā me uppajjantu sahadhammenāti ayaṃ paṭhamo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an4.61:3.1: bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yaso maṃ abbhuggacchatu saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehīti ayaṃ dutiyo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an4.61:4.1: bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yasaṃ laddhā saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehi ciraṃ jīvāmi dīghamāyuṃ pālemīti ayaṃ tatiyo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an4.61:5.1: bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yasaṃ laddhā saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehi ciraṃ jīvitvā dīghamāyuṃ pāletvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjāmīti ayaṃ catuttho dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an4.61:5.2: ime kho gahapati cattāro dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ.
an4.61:6.1: imesaṃ kho gahapati catunnaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ cattāro dhammā paṭilābhāya saṃvattanti
an4.61:7.2: idha gahapati ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an4.61:7.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an4.61:8.2: idha gahapati ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an4.61:9.2: idha gahapati ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena maccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato
an4.61:10.2: abhijjhāvisamalobhābhibhūtena gahapati cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti
an4.61:10.3: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati
an4.61:10.4: byāpādābhibhūtena gahapati cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti
an4.61:10.5: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati
an4.61:10.6: thīnamiddhābhibhūtena gahapati cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti
an4.61:10.7: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati
an4.61:10.8: uddhaccakukkuccābhibhūtena gahapati cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti
an4.61:10.9: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati
an4.61:10.10: vicikicchābhibhūtena gahapati cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti
an4.61:10.11: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati
an4.61:11.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati
an4.61:11.2: byāpādo cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā byāpādaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati
an4.61:11.3: thīnamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā thīnamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati
an4.61:11.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati
an4.61:11.5: vicikicchā cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā vicikicchaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati
an4.61:12.1: yato ca kho gahapati ariyasāvakassa abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti
an4.61:12.5: vicikicchā cittassa upakkilesoti iti viditvā vicikicchā cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti
an4.61:12.6: ayaṃ vuccati gahapati ariyasāvako mahāpañño puthupañño āpāthadaso paññāsampanno
an4.61:12.8: imesaṃ kho gahapati catunnaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ ime cattāro dhammā paṭilābhāya saṃvattanti.
an4.61:13.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi cattāri pattakammāni kattā hoti
an4.61:13.3: idha gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati
an4.61:13.4: mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati
an4.61:13.5: puttadāradāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati
an4.61:13.6: mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati
an4.61:13.7: idamassa paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ gataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
an4.61:14.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi yā tā honti āpadā aggito vā udakato vā rājato vā corato appiyato vā dāyādato vā tathārūpāsu āpadāsu bhogehi pariyodhāya vattati
an4.61:14.3: idamassa dutiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ gataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
an4.61:15.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañca balī kattā hoti
an4.61:15.3: idamassa tatiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ gataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
an4.61:16.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekamattānaṃ damenti ekamattānaṃ samenti ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpenti tathārūpesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ
an4.61:16.2: idamassa catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ gataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
an4.61:17.1: sa kho so gahapati ariyasāvako uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi imāni cattāri pattakammāni kattā hoti.
an4.61:17.2: yassakassaci gahapati aññatra imehi catūhi pattakammehi bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ime vuccanti gahapati bhogā aṭṭhānagatā appattagatā anāyatanasoparibhuttā
an4.61:17.3: yassakassaci gahapati imehi catūhi pattakammehi bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ime vuccanti gahapati bhogā ṭhānagatā pattagatā āyatanaso paribhuttāti.
